== Summary ==
Identified: [[Mark Peterson]] (left, grey checked button-down shirt; matches [[:File:25 May 2003 Columbia Heights tournament winner Mark Peterson.jpg]]) and [[Anthony Lawrence]] (foreground right). Remaining background faces unlabeled.

== Description ==

Game 3: ALaw vs. Mark. At the [[May 2003 Columbia Heights tournament (25 May)]], Twin City Comics, Columbia Heights, Minnesota, 25 May 2003.
